title: Essence
statement: Essence traces shifting states of matter through woven copper wire. Condensed forms descend into fluid movement, dispersing into cloud-like extensions that hover between density and diffusion. Rather than fixed states, the work unfolds through continuous transformation—where solidity and permeability, containment and release, remain mutually constitutive and interchangeable.
statement_zh: 金車文教基金會收藏，現展示於噶瑪蘭威士忌忠孝展售中心。
《 醇 Essence 》 為台灣藝術家洪郁雯的「銅線編織系列」作品之一，創作手法承自傳統編織工藝，選用金屬媒材揉合出嶄新姿態。象徵對釀造工藝的堅持，編織出極致感官饗宴，孕育出台灣威士忌新故鄉的創新精神。
作品中央似若琥珀色酒液般流動，蔓延兩側猶如醇香綻發，詮釋出噶瑪蘭威士忌在風味追尋與探索的臻至展現。
